# Gradle Wrapper

The Gradle Wrapper scripts and `gradle-wrapper.jar` in the imported projects originate from Gradle.
They retain Gradle's Apache License 2.0 and applicable notices; see `gradle-wrapper-LICENSE.txt`.
They are build bootstrap tools, not generated Minecraft plugin binaries, and are not relicensed under MIT or MPL-2.0.

Both imported wrappers point to Gradle 9.8.2. Dependency caches and downloaded distributions are excluded from Git.
